name: OpenAirDisplay (nmt3325 fork)
subtitle: Use an iPad or iPhone as a wireless Mac display
description: AltStore source for the nmt3325 fork of OpenAirDisplay. The IPA is unsigned and must be signed by AltStore, SideStore or LiveContainer on install.

apps.name: OpenAirDisplay
apps.subtitle: Wireless display receiver for macOS
apps.localizedDescription:
OpenAirDisplay turns an iPad or iPhone into an extra wireless display for a Mac running the OpenAirDisplay host app.

This fork adds three-finger swipe space switching and two-finger scroll momentum. Builds are unsigned, so they are signed on device at install time.
